contract: SPROUT_ENGINE_ARCH_2026-10-17.md §1 (data model) + §9 (guardrails). Every engine object carries a schema marker; readers reject unknown versions. P1 ships the four registry entries below as provider globals only — no app wiring until P2.

changelog.change: K-5 lane A: standards_maps/v1 registered (data/standards_maps.json, public sources); skill_tree/v1 gains grade bands K, 1, 2, 4 (standards-mapped, no item content yet) with per-grade statutory_subjects, cat_domains and content fields appended additively; grades preschool/3/5 byte-unchanged.
Initial P1 registry: skill_tree/v1, item/v1, events/v1, mastery/v1.

laws: append-only events: no mutation or deletion API exists on SPROUT_EVENTS (§1E)
mastery gate is 0.80 for every child; profile modifiers never touch scoring (§9)
zero network, zero third-party requests, localStorage only (§8)
guardian gates stay mandatory on placement and every generated plan (§9)
first-names-only PII; no diagnosis vocabulary in schema, UI, or report (§9)

skill_tree/v1.provider: window.SPROUT_CONTENT.skill_tree (P2 wiring) — P1 ships the JSON file only

shape.source: string — MI crosswalk + MONTH1 scaffold provenance

grade_subjects.<grade_band>: string[] — subject union for that grade

<grade_band>.label: string
<grade_band>.statutory_subjects: string[] — (new grades only) per-grade statutory band: K/1/2 = [ela,math,science,social_studies,motor,art,music], 4 = the full MCL nine in engine subject vocabulary
<grade_band>.cat_domains: ["math","ela"] — (new grades only) CAT placement domains once item content lands
<grade_band>.content: string — (new grades only) standards-mapped only; content lane pending

nodes.subject: string — content.json subject vocabulary (math, reading, ...)
nodes.statutory: string|null — MCL subject name; null = enrichment (e.g. coding)
nodes.label: string
standards: string[] — MI standards codes this node claims (empty = codeless practice node)

invariants: node ids unique across all grades
parent and every prereq resolve within the same grade
no cycles in parent or prereq graphs
statutory is one of statutory_subjects or null
subject is in grade_subjects[grade]
K/1/2/4 standard nodes are a 1:1 match with data/standards_maps.json (public CCSS/NGSS/MI codes; asserted by tools/build_engine_data.py)
new grades carry zero items until their content lane lands (validator prints NOTEs, never FAILs)

standards_maps/v1.provenance: public standards documents only, read 2026-10-17 — CCSS ELA + CCSS Mathematics + NGSS K-5 by Topic + Michigan K-12 Social Studies GLCE (URLs + access dates in the file's sources[] and in tools/build_engine_data.py's header)

code_conventions.<area>: string — how the code was normalized (e.g. CCSS cluster letter dropped)

<subject>.label: string — one-line label condensed from the public text

invariants: every K/1/2/4 standard node id in skill_tree/v1 appears here, and every entry here is a standard node (1:1)
codes and labels are copied from the listed public documents — never derived from SPROUT-authored item text
no item/v1 content may be generated from this file

item/v1.extends: sprout/item.v1 (engine repo, commit 5874bdd) — additive only: skill_node, standards, level, exposure_limit, accessibility, cat_domain, grade added; item_id/subject/skill_tag/text/options/answer/provenance/irt preserved

shape.level_rule: string — how level 1..4 is assigned per source

items.subject: string — content.json subject vocabulary
items.cat_domain: math | ela | null — CAT placement domain (null = not served by the 2-domain CAT)
items.skill_node: string — FK -> skill_tree node id (must resolve)
items.skill_tag: string|null — display/legacy tag carried from source
standards: string[] — inherited from the owning skill node
items.level: int 1..4 — human difficulty band alongside irt.b
items.exposure_limit: int — default 3; cap across placement rounds (R7 tiny-bank law)
items.answer: string — verbatim from source (must appear in options)
items.provenance: string — content.json path or generator:<genId> ref
items.irt: optional {a,b,c,calibration} — only on CAT bank items

invariants: every item.skill_node resolves to a skill_tree node of the SAME grade
no orphan items: no item lacks a resolvable skill_node; every node with items is reachable from its strand
item.standards equals its node's standards (inheritance, never hand-set)
answer is one of options; options length 3..6; type in enum
exposure_limit === 3 on every item
>= 16 items per CAT domain per grade (adaptive-lite floor, arch §1B)
every item's text is verbatim from content.json or a generator config (derivation is scripted in tools/build_engine_data.py, never hand-typed)

shape.type: practice | mastery | test | artifact | minutes | placement | adjustment | profile
shape.dedupe_sig: fnv1a32(childId|type|canonical-payload) — idempotency key for the future relay; never suppresses an append

invariants: NO mutation or deletion API exists — append-only law (§1E)
lines are strictly ordered by append; eid sequence never decreases
identical payloads produce identical dedupe_sig (key-order independent)
proficiency report (P5) is a pure function of these lines; log outranks any table

<node_id>.last_event_id: string|null — eid of the last mastery event
<node_id>.state_label: Not started | In progress | Reviewed — neutral child-facing labels only (§9)

algorithm.bkt: port of /root/sprout/sprout/mastery/bkt.py — p_init 0.20, p_transition 0.15, p_slip 0.10, p_guess 0.10
algorithm.leitner: port of /root/sprout/sprout/mastery/reviews.py — boxes [1,2,4,7,15] days, monotonic on recall, lapse -> box 1
algorithm.anti_grind: state=mastered requires p_known >= gate AND >=1 non-practice evidence (test|artifact|placement); practice taps alone never produce mastered (§1C)

invariants: p_known in [0.01, 0.99]; attempts/correct non-decreasing
every state change appends an events/v1 line; last_event_id points at it
gate is never lowered per child (§9: no scoring modifiers)
state_label uses neutral vocabulary only — no 'remedial' label reaches a child (§9)

existing_schemas_referenced.placement/v1: demo app.js finishAssessment() — unchanged in P1
existing_schemas_referenced.year_plan/v0: demo app.js buildYearPlan() — unchanged in P1
existing_schemas_referenced.sprout/item.v1: engine repo /root/sprout/sprout/json_schemas/item.v1.schema.json (commit 5874bdd) — extended additively by item/v1 above
